nodes.text: explore 0 (web-domain-researcher 0): Use one explore sub-agent to own the rail branch. Check current date, resolve the three specific station codes, exhaust both 2026-03-10 high-speed result sets, select one feasible service per route from returned times/durations, and preserve the business-class fare/availability plus the actual train_no where needed. Return both selected legs with route counts and validation. Do not write files, alter rail state, or create deliverables.

explore 1 (financial-market-analyst 0): Use one explore sub-agent to own only the read-only GOOGL branch. Retrieve GOOGL info and 30-day price history, requested annual income-statement rows, recommendations, and the latest five returned news records. Compute its 30-day change from first and last source observations, preserve dates/values/units, distinguish absent fields from zero, and normalize billions only after retaining raw values. Return history row/date controls, statement years, prices, metrics, recommendation counts, five news records, and validation. Do not query AMZN or write files.

explore 2 (financial-market-analyst 1): Use one explore sub-agent to own only the read-only AMZN branch. Retrieve AMZN info and 30-day price history, compute the change from first and last source observations, preserve dates/values/units, and distinguish absent fields from zero. Return compact history row/date controls, prices, metrics, and validation. Do not query GOOGL, write files, or create deliverables.

explore 3 (web-domain-researcher 1): Use one explore sub-agent to own the read-only meeting-coordination branch. Search the inbox for exact subjects `Q1 2026 Roadshow - Schedule Request` from `investors@fundmanager.com` and `Availability Confirmed - March 10 Meeting` from `shanghai_partners@finance.com`; paginate both result sets, read every candidate, and match by complete sender, recipient, and subject rather than subject alone. Return the exact requested schedule/materials details and the Shanghai partner's stated availability constraint, with message IDs and matching controls. Do not send or modify email.

coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): Use one coder sub-agent to own `<workspace_root>/Roadshow_Analysis.xlsx` exclusively. Create Travel_Plan, Stock_Summary, and Financial_Highlights from the canonical payload with the exact required columns, two travel/ticker rows as applicable, at least two GOOGL fiscal years, business class, literal numbers, and correctly converted billion-USD fields. Read back all sheets and return the path, sheet order, row counts, ticker/year controls, and validation. Do not create the presentation or send email.

coder 1 (office-report-builder 1): Use one coder sub-agent to own `<workspace_root>/Investor_Roadshow.pptx` exclusively. Create the deck exactly once with at least the five required slides, using only the canonical itinerary and finance facts; include both cities, GOOGL financials, GOOGL-versus-AMZN 30-day comparison, and analyst consensus without unsupported claims. Read it back and return path, slide count/titles, ticker coverage, and validation. Do not write the workbook or send email.
